test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a city, a school is 18 km towards the north of a park. A hospital is 21 km towards the west of the school. A restaurant is 21 km towards the west of the park. How far and in which direction is the restaurant from the hospital?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given:

Park is at reference point (0, 0)
School is 18 km North of Park → (0, 18)
Hospital is 21 km West of School → (-21, 18)
Restaurant is 21 km West of Park → (-21, 0)

According to the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ba7df262dc087ce28d3dd5f8e74b8f919056f993c1ab4807a450bc99f5e9ecb.png] 

So, Restaurant is 18 km directly South of Hospital.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**
